result.instructions: Tools for Formspark, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Show me the 20 newest submissions across my workspace."; "Find the submissions that mention 'invoice' in any field."; "Which of my forms send notifications, and to which addresses?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Formspark data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run formspark_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run formspark_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run formspark_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. formspark_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: formspark_whoami
tools.title: Describe the API token
tools.description: Describe the API token in use: its name, scopes, expiry and last use. Good first call to see what this connection can read. Formspark API: GET /me.

tools.name: formspark_list_workspaces
tools.title: List workspaces
tools.description: List the workspaces this token can reach, with plan (FREE or an upgraded plan), submission quota and timestamps. Use the ids in the other tools. Formspark API: GET /workspaces.

startingAfter.description: Cursor: the nextCursor of the previous page. Opaque; do not build one.

tools.name: formspark_list_forms
tools.title: List forms
tools.description: List the forms in one workspace, with name, notification emails, threading and spam settings. Formspark API: GET /forms.

startingAfter.description: Cursor: the nextCursor of the previous page. Opaque; do not build one.

tools.name: formspark_get_form
tools.title: Get a form
tools.description: Get one form by id, including its settings and notification emails. Captcha secrets are never returned. Formspark API: GET /forms/{formId}.

tools.name: formspark_list_form_submissions
tools.title: List a form's submissions
tools.description: List the newest submissions of one form, with their field values and timestamps. Pass nextCursor back as startingAfter for the next page. Formspark API: GET /forms/{formId}/submissions.

startingAfter.description: Cursor: the nextCursor of the previous page. Opaque; do not build one.

search.description: Text to search for in the submissions.

tools.name: formspark_list_workspace_submissions
tools.title: List a workspace's submissions
tools.description: List the newest submissions across every form in one workspace. Pass nextCursor back as startingAfter for the next page. Formspark API: GET /workspaces/{workspaceId}/submissions.

startingAfter.description: Cursor: the nextCursor of the previous page. Opaque; do not build one.

search.description: Text to search for in the submissions.

tools.name: formspark_create_form
tools.title: Create a form
tools.description: Create a form in a workspace with a name, an optional description and notification emails. Needs an upgraded workspace and the forms:write scope. Formspark API: POST /forms.

name.description: The form name, shown in the dashboard.

description.description: A short description for the team.

notificationEmails.description: Addresses that get an email for each submission.

emailThreading.description: Group the notification emails into one thread.

tools.name: formspark_update_form
tools.title: Update a form
tools.description: Change a form's name, description, notification emails or threading. Sends only the fields you pass; null clears a text field. Formspark API: PATCH /forms/{formId}.

description.description: The new description, or null to clear it.

notificationEmails.description: The full new list of notification addresses (replaces the list).

emailThreading.description: Group the notification emails into one thread.
